roleplays.situation: Your train is cancelled and you must reach another city tonight.
roleplays.goal: ask for options, compare trade-offs, choose one

roleplays.situation: A product you bought does not match the description, but the store offers only partial compensation.
roleplays.goal: explain the issue, negotiate, confirm the outcome

roleplays.situation: A friend repeatedly arrives late and asks why it bothers you.
roleplays.goal: describe impact, stay diplomatic, set a boundary

roleplays.situation: You must defend a controversial change to a school curriculum.
roleplays.goal: state rationale, answer objections, qualify claims

roleplays.situation: A family member wants to use an AI service for a sensitive decision.
Your schedule makes an ideal routine impossible.
roleplays.goal: prioritize, make a realistic plan, explain trade-offs

roleplays.situation: A project is late because a dependency was not available.
Two teams disagree about whether to spend more money to protect a deadline.
